SELECT r.behavior_code AS behaviorCode, bt.label AS behaviorLabel, SUM(r.frequency) AS frequency FROM behavior_record r JOIN observation_session os ON os.id = r.observation_session_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = r.behavior_code
GROUP BY r.behavior_code, bt.label ORDER BY frequency DESC, r.behavior_code

SELECT DATE(r.record_time) AS date, SUM(r.frequency) AS totalFrequency FROM behavior_record r JOIN observation_session os ON os.id = r.observation_session_id
GROUP BY DATE(r.record_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT os.environment_code AS environmentCode, et.label AS environmentLabel, SUM(r.frequency) AS frequency FROM behavior_record r JOIN observation_session os ON os.id = r.observation_session_id JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = os.environment_code
GROUP BY os.environment_code, et.label ORDER BY frequency DESC, os.environment_code
